==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Flame, not lame-hurry up.wav|a=US}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb|*}}

# {{lb|en|emphatic|ambitransitive}} To [[hurry]]; to increase the [[speed]] of doing something.
#* {{RQ:Bramah Bravo of London|passage="Oh, I think I'll just give a look to see if Geoffrey is in sight yet and '''hurry him up''' if he is," she called back.}}

====Synonyms====
* {{l|en|get a move on}}
* {{l|en|get one's skates on}}
* {{l|en|hurry up the cakes}} {{q|US, dated}}

====Derived terms====
* [[hurry up and wait]]
* [[hurry-up offense]]
* [[hurry-up wagon]]
* [[on the hurry up]]
